pieces.Text: When you cast miracle, you state what you would like to have happen and request that the power to which you are connected intercede. A request that is out of line with the power's nature is refused. A miracle can do any of the following things - Duplicate any mystic spell of 6th level or lower; Duplicate any other spell of 5th level or lower; Undo the harmful effects of certain spells, such as feeblemind; Produce any effect whose power level is in line with the above effects. At the GM's discretion, you may try to use a miracle to produce greater effects than these, but doing so may be dangerous or the spell may have only a partial effect. A duplicated spell allows saving throws and spell resistance as normal, but the save DCs are the same as for a 7th-level spell. For the purpose of other effects that depend on spell level, miracle counts as a 9th-level spell.
